description: Core permissions, native HTTP to the user's loomcycle, and the app's own sign-in commands. The loomcycle URL is user-entered (local/LAN/remote, arbitrary port), so the HTTP scope must be broad. The port MUST be an explicit wildcard (*:*): the plugin does not auto-wildcard the port, so http(s)://** matches only the default port and rejects e.g. :8787/:8788. `*` also matches an empty port, so portless URLs still match. The sign-in commands are granted to the main window only (build.rs declares them, so no other webview may call them).
